events.label: founding
events.text: Squadron formed during the First World War.

evidence.quote: was formed on 2 July 1917 during the First World War

events.text: Squadron moved to RFC Lilbourne, near Rugby, eight days after formation.

evidence.quote: Eight days after , the new unit moved to RFC Lilbourne , near Rugby .

events.label: training
events.text: Training refocused toward combat operations after Programme of Development received.

evidence.quote: From September 1917 , this became more specifically targeted towards operating in combat

events.label: re-equipment
events.text: Squadron began re-equipping entirely with Sopwith Camels.

evidence.quote: From November 1917 , the squadron began to re-equip entirely with Sopwith Camels

events.label: fatality
events.text: Squadron's first fatality: 2nd Lt Rawbone died of crash injuries.

evidence.quote: crashed at the aerodrome on 7 December 1917 and died from his injuries on 18 December

events.text: Squadron deployed to France in stages through January 1918.

evidence.quote: By stages , the unit deployed to France through January 1918

events.text: Full squadron complement based at Liettres, available for operations.

evidence.quote: by the 20th , the full squadron complement was based at Liettres and available for operations

events.text: First patrols flown after delay due to bad weather.

evidence.quote: the first patrols were not sent up until 30 January

events.text: Squadron flew its first offensive patrols over enemy lines.

evidence.quote: The first offensive patrols over enemy lines took place on 18 February 1918

events.text: All 18 Camels patrolled a line between Roeselare and Menin.

evidence.quote: On the 20th , all 18 Camels , divided into three Flights patrolled a line between Roeselare and Menin

events.text: First combat report completed by Captain Gus Orlebar.

evidence.quote: the first combat report was completed by Captain Gus Orlebar

events.text: Squadron moved to south of British Front for low-level strafing.

evidence.quote: In March 1918 the squadron was moved to the south of the British Front

events.text: Squadron attached to Tank Corps for anti-tank gun strafing duties.

evidence.quote: In August the squadron was attached to the Tank Corps for special duties

events.label: reformation
events.text: Squadron reformed, equipped with Hawker Furys.

evidence.quote: The squadron reformed on 15 March 1937 equipped with Hawker Furys

events.text: Squadron posted to North-East France at outbreak of war.

evidence.quote: In September 1939 , 73 Squadron , along with No . 1 Squadron were then posted to North-East France

events.text: Squadron moved to Rouvres.

evidence.quote: before a move to Rouvres in October

events.text: Squadron withdrew from France.

evidence.quote: On 17 June 1940 the squadron had withdrawn from France

events.text: Squadron operated from Debden during Battle of Britain, until late October.

evidence.quote: operating from Debden on 5 September until late October

events.text: Unit withdrew from Debden in preparation for Middle East move.

evidence.quote: until late October , when the unit withdrew in preparation for a move to the Middle East

events.label: re-equipment
events.text: Squadron converted to Spitfire.

evidence.quote: In June 1943 the squadron converted to the Spitfire

events.text: Squadron posted to Italy.

evidence.quote: and were posted to Italy in October

events.text: Squadron began fighter-bomber operations over the Balkans.

evidence.quote: In April 1944 the squadron began to operate over the Balkans , in the fighter-bomber role

events.text: Part of squadron moved to Greece.

evidence.quote: In December 1944 part of the squadron was moved to Greece

events.text: Squadron returned to Italy.

evidence.quote: In January 1945 the squadron returned to Italy

events.text: Squadron moved to Yugoslavia.

evidence.quote: and in April moved to Yugoslavia

events.text: Squadron moved to Malta.

evidence.quote: moving to Malta in July 1945

events.text: Squadron moved to Habbaniya, Iraq.

evidence.quote: was moved to Habbaniya in Iraq in May 1953

events.text: Squadron was based in Cyprus.

evidence.quote: In 1955 it was in Cyprus

events.text: Squadron deployed to Aden for the Suez Crisis, through 1957.

evidence.quote: deployed to Aden from 1956–57 for the Suez Crisis

events.text: Squadron arrived at Akrotiri, joining Middle East Air Force Strike Wing.

evidence.quote: The squadron arrived in Akrotiri in March 1957

events.label: disbandment
events.text: Squadron disbanded.

evidence.quote: It was disbanded in 1969
The squadron was disbanded on 10 January 1969
